opus_summary: 多位玩家分享了《GTA6》的主线通关时间，分别为42小时、约65小时、70小时和115小时，游玩方式各有不同。其中一人在70小时首次通关时完成了71%的清单，另一人在115小时通关后整体完成率为72%。

paragraphs.en: In every sense of the word, Grand Theft Auto 6 is a massive game. But just how much time will you have to set aside to see all of it? Well, that could potentially take years given the size of its map and the incredible amount of detail packed into it – we’re still exploring to find its many hidden secrets, hours after finishing the main mission chain. What we can give you an idea of, though, is just how long it took us to finish the story.
paragraphs.cn: 从各个意义上说，《GTA6》都是一款规模庞大的游戏。但你究竟需要留出多少时间才能看遍其中的一切？考虑到地图的规模以及其中包含的海量细节，这可能需要花上数年——在完成主线任务链数小时后，我们仍在探索，寻找游戏中众多隐藏的秘密。不过，我们可以告诉你我们花了多长时间完成故事，好让你有个概念。

paragraphs.en: Everyone plays games differently, so read on for more details about how everyone played, how long it took to reach the credits, and some of their unique thoughts about the game's length. Once you've finished the game yourself, be sure to submit your times on How Long To Beat and see how your time compares!
paragraphs.cn: 每个人玩游戏的方式都不同，所以请继续往下看，了解大家各自是怎么玩的、花了多久看到制作人员名单，以及他们对游戏时长的一些独到看法。等你自己完成游戏后，别忘了在How Long To Beat上提交你的用时，看看和大家相比如何！

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is a big game. So big, in fact, that even the 70 hours it took me to reach the end credits felt rushed at times. I started off sticking to the critical path, mainly focusing on Jason and Lucia’s main missions in Chapter 1, as I didn’t quite know how long the journey ahead was going to take me. To some extent, this whole opening act feels like an extended tutorial, and once the game really finds its rhythm in Chapter 2, I began to take things a little steadier, making sure to complete all optional missions before moving on to the next slice of story. This method of playing continued until I reached the end. Well, the first of many endings I have found so far. I’m not sure how many ways the couple’s tale can wrap up, but I’ve found four so far. I’ll leave what those are, and how you get them, up to you to find out, though.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》是一款大型游戏。事实上，它大到即便我花了70小时才看到片尾制作人员名单，有时仍觉得自己玩得太匆忙了。起初我紧跟主线，主要专注于第一章中Jason和Lucia的主线任务，因为我不太清楚接下来的旅程要花多久。从某种程度上说，整个开场部分感觉像一段加长版教程，而当游戏在第二章真正进入节奏后，我开始放慢了一点速度，确保完成所有可选任务后再推进下一段剧情。我一直以这种方式玩到了结尾。准确地说，是我目前发现的众多结局中的第一个。我不确定这对情侣的故事有多少种收尾方式，但目前我已经发现了四种。不过，这些结局是什么，以及如何达成，就留给你自己去发现了。

paragraphs.en: Upon first finishing at that 70-hour mark, I had achieved 71% of GTA 6’s 100% checklist, meaning there were still plenty of activities to do, collectibles to find, cars to steal, and people to meet left for me in Leonida. I’ve since put in another 30 hours and only pushed 1% further, as I’ve been slowly exploring the vast map that stretches well beyond Vice City. There are a ludicrous number of collectibles to find in this game, including hundreds of playing cards, which really do feel like finding a needle in a haystack each and every time you stumble across them.
paragraphs.cn: 在玩到70小时时首次通关后，我完成了《GTA6》100%完成度清单中的71%，这意味着我在Leonida还有大量活动可以参与、收藏品可以寻找、汽车可以偷窃、人物可以结识。此后我又投入了30小时，完成度却只提高了1%，因为我一直在慢慢探索这张远不止于Vice City的广阔地图。游戏中有数量惊人的收藏品等待寻找，其中包括数百张扑克牌，每次偶然发现它们，真的都感觉像是在大海捞针。

paragraphs.en: Those shall wait for another day, though. As will achieving that full 100%. For now, I’ve started a fresh save, already making my way through Chapter 1 again in an effort to see how GTA 6’s story changes and the missions within it branch when you try to keep Jason and Lucia’s relationship as frosty as possible. I won’t lie, though, it’s tough. Rockstar has done a phenomenal job at building a bond between them, and in my original 70 hours I was compelled to keep them at a full “hot together” relationship rating, so having to tear them out of my heart now feels quite painful. It’s all in the name of science, I guess.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这些还是留待以后再说吧。达成100%完成度也是如此。眼下，我已经新开了一个存档，再次开始体验第一章，想看看当你尽可能让Jason和Lucia的关系保持冷淡时，《GTA6》的故事会如何变化，其中的任务又会如何分支。不过说实话，这很难。Rockstar在塑造两人之间的羁绊方面做得非常出色，在最初的70小时里，我忍不住让他们的关系评级始终保持在满格的「hot together」，所以现在不得不把他们从心里割舍出去，感觉相当痛苦。我想，这一切都是为了科学。

paragraphs.en: With the extraordinarily rare luxury of having more than three weeks to play through Grand Theft Auto 6 in order to write IGN’s review , I was actually able to move through it in pretty much precisely the same sort of way I would’ve if I’d been playing exclusively for pleasure. For me, this means allowing myself to be constantly distracted by minigames, exploring interesting areas, and stopping for every stranger I encounter. There was really no point where I ever ignored doing something I felt like doing because I felt obligated to tackle a story mission instead. As a result, it took me 115 hours to reach GTA 6’s finale.
paragraphs.cn: 为了撰写IGN的评测，我获得了超过三周时间来玩通《GTA6》，享受到了这种极为罕见的奢侈待遇，因此实际上我能够以几乎与纯粹为享乐而玩时完全一样的方式推进游戏。对我来说，这意味着任由自己不断被小游戏吸引，探索有趣的区域，并为遇到的每个陌生人停下脚步。我从未因为觉得自己必须去做剧情任务，而放弃做任何自己想做的事。结果，我花了115小时才到达《GTA6》的结局。

paragraphs.en: My Jason and Lucia maintained a professional criminal rating throughout thanks to my style of play, where I typically opt for non-lethal takedowns against general law enforcement, disabling vehicles by popping tyres rather than pummeling the windscreens with gunfire, and leaving civilians alone. By the end of the story, I had actually only killed 11 civilians, all of whom were accidents.
paragraphs.cn: 由于我的游玩风格，我操控的Jason和Lucia全程保持着职业罪犯评级：面对普通执法人员时，我通常选择非致命制服；对付车辆时，我会打爆轮胎让它们失去行动能力，而不是朝挡风玻璃猛烈开火；我也不会招惹平民。到故事结束时，我实际上只杀死了11名平民，而且全都是意外。

paragraphs.en: I’ve seen two endings so far, and my overall completion rate is at 72% now that I’ve reached the end of the story, but I feel I’m likely to simply start again at this point rather than push this save to 100%. This is because I actually really want to experience it from the beginning again, only slower . More racing, more fishing, more exploring; I want to see how long it’ll take me without a deadline – even if that deadline was a surprisingly generous one. And can I reach the end without killing a single civilian? I’m about to find out.
paragraphs.cn: 目前我已经看过两个结局，故事结束时我的总完成度为72%，但我觉得现阶段我很可能会直接重新开始，而不是把这个存档的完成度推到100%。这是因为我真的很想从头再体验一次，只是要更慢一些。多参加比赛、多钓鱼、多探索；我想看看没有截止期限的话，我会花上多久——即便那个截止期限给的时间宽裕得令人意外。另外，我能否在不杀死任何平民的情况下走到结尾？我马上就要找到答案了。

paragraphs.en: It took me about 65 hours to complete GTA 6's story, which I expect to be on the faster end compared to most other reviewers, and there's a bit of a caveat which explains that, too: I opted to really focus hard on the main story and character-based side missions in the final quarter of it or so. For a short while, towards the end, I actually got in-game taxis between missions to "fast travel" and speed progress up, partially to test how that might affect the game world – so much of the game is discovered while travelling; what happens if you skip that? – and partially just so I could make sure I got to the end in time.
paragraphs.cn: 我花了大约65小时完成《GTA6》的故事，我预计这个速度相比其他大多数评测者会偏快，而这也有一点需要说明：在大约最后四分之一的流程中，我选择集中精力完成主线故事和以角色为中心的支线任务。临近结尾时，有那么一小段时间，我实际上是在任务之间搭乘游戏内的出租车来「快速旅行」，加快进度，一部分是为了测试这可能会如何影响游戏世界——游戏中有那么多东西是在旅途中发现的；如果跳过这些会怎样？——另一部分则只是为了确保我能及时通关。

paragraphs.en: Saying that, I've still done all of the character-based side missions that I'm aware of, and just have a few of the more significant questlines that come from 'emergent events' to get through (although I get the sense there are dozens and dozens of smaller one-off versions of these still to see). There are still corners of the map to properly explore, and I've only scraped the surface of some systems like fishing, diving, and racing. Between hitting your savings goals and doing all of the side activities, let alone just hanging out and following your interests as you go, I'd still need well over a hundred hours with it. I wouldn't expect many people to finish the story in under 70 hours and honestly wouldn't recommend it either. Take your time with it – the game's at its best when it's played slow!
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，我还是完成了所有我所知道的以角色为中心的支线任务，只剩下几条由「突发事件」引出的较重要任务线还没完成（不过我感觉仍有数十个较小的一次性同类事件尚未见到）。地图上仍有一些角落需要好好探索，而钓鱼、潜水和赛车等系统，我也只是浅尝辄止。光是达成存款目标和完成所有支线活动，更不用说闲逛并随心所欲地做感兴趣的事，我还需要远超一百小时。我不认为会有多少人在70小时内完成故事，老实说我也不建议这么做。慢慢享受吧——慢慢玩才能体验到这款游戏最好的一面！

paragraphs.en: The vast majority of my time in Leonida has been spent with the main campaign missions, akin to what you might call a mainline, even “rushed” playthrough. It took me exactly 42 hours to finish Jason and Lucia's story, and a handful of those hours were spent doing optional activities like side missions, playing minigolf, stealing motorised scooters, and simply wandering around the huge metropolis that is Vice City.
paragraphs.cn: 我在Leonida度过的绝大部分时间都花在了主战役任务上，类似于一种可以称作直奔主线、甚至是「匆忙」的玩法。我恰好花了42小时完成Jason和Lucia的故事，其中有几个小时用来进行可选活动，比如支线任务、玩迷你高尔夫、偷电动滑板车，以及单纯地在Vice City这座庞大的都市里闲逛。

paragraphs.en: That might sound disappointing if you were expecting a 100+ ﻿hour epic, or if you were putting a lot of stock into the quote that mentioned 80 hours a few months ago, but this isn't the kind of game you ideally want to rush. Take your time with it, explore the ridiculously impressive open-world, and allow it to divert your attention towards any number of activities that aren't directly connected to the main storyline. ﻿There's so much more to do beyond just the core campaign, and I reckon some players will easily reach 80 hours or more before they get to the end credits.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你期待的是一部超过100小时的史诗，或者十分看重几个月前那句提到80小时的话，这听起来可能会让你失望，但这并不是那种理想情况下应该匆忙玩完的游戏。慢慢体验，探索这个令人印象深刻得不可思议的开放世界，让游戏把你的注意力引向各种与主线故事没有直接联系的活动。除了核心战役之外，还有太多事情可做，我认为有些玩家在看到片尾制作人员名单之前，很容易就会玩到80小时甚至更久。

paragraphs.en: Now that I've hustled my way through it for the Pure Xbox review , my plan is to go back through the campaign at a much slower pace over the next few weeks and months, and I can't wait to see what surprises I missed the first time around. There are parts of the map I haven't even visited yet!
paragraphs.cn: 现在我已经为了Pure XBOX的评测匆忙通关，接下来我打算在未来几周、几个月里以慢得多的速度重新体验战役，迫不及待地想看看第一次错过了哪些惊喜。地图上有些地方我甚至还没去过！

paragraphs.en: So, that’s how long it took each of us to finish GTA 6’s main story. How are you planning to play Rockstar’s latest? And how are you going to play as Jason and Lucia? In or out of love? As violent psychos or clean professionals? Let us know in the comments.
paragraphs.cn: 以上就是我们每个人完成《GTA6》主线故事所花的时间。你打算怎么玩Rockstar的最新作品？又准备如何扮演Jason和Lucia？让他们相爱还是不相爱？做暴力疯子还是干净利落的专业人士？请在评论中告诉我们。

paragraphs.en: For more GTA 6, make sure to check out our review , or head over to our launch live blog , where I’ll be doing my best to answer as many of your spoiler-free questions as you may have about the game.
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《GTA6》的内容，别忘了查看我们的评测，或前往我们的发售直播博客，我会在那里尽力回答你们对游戏提出的尽可能多的不涉及剧透的问题。
